svg.title: Two-way set-associative L1 cache lookup

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: L1 cache organisation — 4 KiB, 2-way, 128 sets, 16-byte lines

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both caches share this geometry. A lookup reads both ways of one set; the data cache reads them a cycle early, at the address the core announces.
